name: Napa County Mental Health Crisis Line
description: Napa County's 24-hour mental health crisis hotline provides immediate support for Napa County residents of all ages experiencing a mental health crisis or emergency.
fullDescription: Napa County's 24-hour mental health crisis hotline provides immediate support for Napa County residents of all ages experiencing a mental health crisis or emergency.
whatTheyOffer:
- 24/7 crisis support for all ages
- Anyone in crisis is seen and assessed regardless of eligibility
- Crisis Stabilization Services (short-term care lasting less than 24 hours)
- Intake and referrals to county mental health services
- Bilingual English/Spanish services
howToGetIt: Call 707-253-4711, 24 hours a day. The Crisis Stabilization Services Program is at 2751 Napa Valley Corporate Way, Building B, Napa. For a life-threatening emergency, call 911.
keywords: Napa County, mental health crisis, crisis stabilization, psychiatric emergency, bilingual
